title: Where Your $9 Starbucks Order Goes
sentence: Using Starbucks' fiscal 2026 income statement, a $9 order splits into about $4.08 for running coffeehouses, $2.91 for product and distribution, $1.14 for head office, depreciation and restructuring, $0.27 net for interest and taxes, and about $0.60 of net profit (company-wide average, our calculation); the coffee in a grande latte costs about 13 cents (our estimate at November 2026 arabica prices).
